newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU aid to allow Bulgaria to service 1997-98 debt.
newsitem.headline: EU aid to allow Bulgaria to service 1997-98 debt.

text.p: New aid announced by the European Commission on Wednesday will allow Bulgaria to service its 1997-98 external debt, the country's deputy prime minister said.

"With this support that we will be getting, we will be able to service our debts in 1997-1998," Alexander Ander Boshkov told a news conference after a joint meeting of the Group of 24 countries in Brussels.
Boshkov said that four weeks ago Bulgaria had been unable to service $58 million of its debts and had asked for this to be rolled over until next year.

At the meeting, the European Commission said it would propose untied balance-of-payments support for Sofia of up to 250 million Ecus ($285 million) plus up to 40 million Ecus ($46 million) from its PHARE programme, which aids emerging eastern European democracies.
